test_title: PYST 47: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: LR 9 is related to PT 3 in a certain way. In the same way, TS 13 is related to XU 7. To which of the given options is GE 19 related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3eb80c468629d30ae070c268aa19ef155f417588f8eb451aa13d706433949c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, LR 9 → PT 3

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4c3e0fbab50f3a15f70f96973b56fe2d6d6bd9e09615ba31f15d614819c94ae.png] 

For, TS 13 → XU 7

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b6af1ed93050f46f053ae34d3b449fdd42e0fcb51811cc09827f0f7c2d35b0d.png] 

Now, apply the same to GE 19:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/615acc76e3336dc9541eef89fe70b6f7ea7c2a83ac0b721abb37e24d898e26e3.png] 

So, GE 19 → KG 13

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2.**
